componentViews.description: The MMAR Metamodeling Client consists of various components for managing selected objects, communicating with the backend, and providing a rich user interface for metamodel design.
componentViews.title: Component Diagram: MMAR Metamodeling Client

componentViews.description: The MMAR API Server consists of controllers that handle HTTP requests, connection classes for database operations, and shared services. The architecture follows a layered design with controllers, data access, and service layers.
componentViews.title: Component Diagram: MMAR API Server

containerViews.description: The MMAR platform consists of three main clients (Modeling, Metamodeling, and VizRep) that connect to a common backend server. The server provides REST APIs for metamodel and model operations, while the database stores all relevant data.
containerViews.title: Container Diagram: MMAR Clients, Backend and Database

systemContextViews.description: Creators and End Users interact with two facets of the MMAR platform. Creators design metamodels (and their visual representations) using the Metamodeling System, while End Users create models using the Modeling System. Both systems rely on a common MMAR Server and Database backend.
systemContextViews.title: System Context: MMAR Metamodeling vs. Modeling Systems
